TanStack Router root route.description:
Declare the root route in src/routes/__root.tsx. Requires createRootRoute and Outlet from @tanstack/react-router.

在 src/routes/__root.tsx 中声明根路由；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 createRootRoute 与 Outlet。

TanStack Router root route with context.description:
Declare a root route that types the router context every route inherits. The same shape must be passed to createRouter as its context option. Requires createRootRouteWithContext and Outlet from @tanstack/react-router.

声明带类型化 router context 的根路由，该 context 为所有路由继承；同样的形状必须作为 createRouter 的 context 传入；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 createRootRouteWithContext 与 Outlet。

body: import { HeadContent, Outlet, Scripts, createRootRoute } from '@tanstack/react-router';
TanStack Router root document (TypeScrip.description:
Complete server-rendered root route that owns the HTML document. Requires @tanstack/react-router and a server-rendering setup such as TanStack Start.

完整的服务端渲染根路由，负责整份 HTML 文档；需要 @tanstack/react-router，以及 TanStack Start 一类的服务端渲染配置。
